article.content: Black Agenda Radio November 27, 2026 Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Thu, 11/26/2026 - 06:32 Black Agenda Radio · Black Agenda Radio November 27, 2026 In this week’s segment, we hear about Chicago’s politics, its mayoral election, and why wealthy donors in the city are backing a candidate to oppose incumbent Brandon Johnson. But we begin with a lawsuit filed against Baltimore County Public Schools and the Police Department after four teens were searched at gunpoint over an erroneous report of a gun caused by an A.I. surveillance system that routinely produces false reports of firearms.
